name: Leadership team
focus: Decide priorities and resources; review the KYC metrics monthly.

name: Product · Onboarding
focus: Owns the approval-rate metric and the onboarding flow.

name: Engineering · Onboarding platform
focus: Owns integrations, retries and the response to execution errors.

name: Data & Analytics
focus: Owns metric definitions, events, data quality and alerts.

name: Operations · KYC review
focus: Owns manual review, if one exists or is introduced.

name: Customer Support
focus: Owns what declined applicants are told.

name: Vendor management
focus: Owns the verification vendor relationship and contract.

name: Compliance
focus: Owns KYC policy and the control findings.

name: Finance
focus: Owns unit economics and vendor cost.

name: Country leads
focus: Give local knowledge of documents and regulations.
